title: Canonical codec moves to @inventarch/graph
summary: canonical, digest, copy and CodecError are exported from @inventarch/graph beside stableSerialize; @inventarch/session-system depends on graph, re-exports CodecError and wraps canonical, digest and copy so their refusals are SessionError, which now extends CodecError (refusal codes are unchanged); @inventarch/distribution imports the codec from graph and no longer depends on session-system. Digests are byte-identical, pinned by a vector test; workspace revisions are untouched.
